title: Hinge Health Session Completion Percent Leaderboard
dataSources: MedBridge exercises (`medbridge:exercise`), PT clinic sessions (`pt:session`), Hinge Health sessions (`hingehealth:session`), rehab range-of-motion logs (`rehab:rom`), and pain diary entries (`pain:diary`).
app: MedBridge exercise completions, clinic PT session exports, Hinge Health digital sessions, ROM measurement logs, and pain diary entries forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hingehealth:session completion_pct=*
| stats sum(completion_pct) as total_value, avg(completion_pct) as avg_value by program_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks program values by total and average completion percent across Hinge Health session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `completion_pct` values for each Hinge Health session event and review total and average completion percent by program.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total completion percent.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which program shows the biggest completion percent numbers in your Hinge Health session data.
